grouping_rationale: Two groups minimize worker count while separating the genuinely different operational list-state proofs from higher-order named-spec/magic-wand derivations. Group sizes 5 and 3 are below the controller maximum of 12.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove sequentially using xizi_sll_to_target_not_same/same/zero_nonzero, xizi_sllseg_len1, xizi_sllseg_sllseg, xizi_sllseg_sll, xizi_sll_head_from_cons, and xizi_sll_head_split_target. Normalize lists and pointer equalities before direct sep_apply. For which_implies, unfold the folded head branch and sep_apply xizi_sll_head_split_target directly in both disjuncts. Never use derivable1_trans or any name from forbidden_lemma.md.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: One linked-list traversal proof family; keeping the initialization, loop transition, impossible exit, and return reconstruction together lets one worker reuse exact predicate unfoldings.

premise_discharge.xizi_sll_head_split_target: head != 0 is inside xizi_sll_head or explicit in the exposed branch

proof_groups.forbidden_lemma_requirement: Scan both manual and any group-local case_lib change against every forbidden name; no helper should be needed in this group.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: forall (node : Z) (l : list Z), In node l -> exists prefix suffix, l = prefix ++ node :: suffix /\ ~ In node prefix /\ xizi_sll_remove_first node l = prefix ++ suffix
candidate_helper_declarations.proof_hint: Induct on l; decide current=node with Z.eq_dec. In the equal branch choose nil/suffix; in the unequal branch recurse using the tail membership fact and prepend current, preserving not-In and the Fixpoint equation.

premises.discharged_by: the strong postcondition in each derivation witness
premises.arithmetic: derive node <> NULL from store validity/address layout
premises.spatial_resource: convert defined points-to to undef points-to with store_ptr_undef_store_ptr

candidate_helper_declarations.proof_hint: Unfold xizi_sll_node and field constants, derive the non-null pure fact from the exact store, sep_apply store_ptr_undef_store_ptr to the exact field, then entailer; do not use a framed monotonicity lemma.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Instantiate tail with (prefix,nil), front with (nil,suffix), and member with the first-hit split returned by the suffixed helper. Preserve the strong pre, introduce each strong-post wand, normalize app/remove_first, then sep_apply the suffixed node-field helper to the exact detached field and cancel the head predicate. The member proof must be an in-place rewrite/direct sep_apply proof and must not call derivable1_sepcon_mono or any forbidden lemma.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: All three are named-spec derivations with the same wand and detached-node conversion; member adds one pure list helper. This strategy is distinct enough from loop-state proofs to justify the second and final group.

premise_discharge.node_field_to_node: the exact detached target.node_next field is in every strong post

proof_groups.forbidden_lemma_requirement: Neither helper proof nor any witness proof may contain a name from forbidden_lemma.md; especially reject derivable1_sepcon_mono and derivable1_trans before group-check.
